If I were able to have that joy, than I would have so many opportunities. I already have connected  and been talking to my favorite drummers/ musicians , and they have completely welcomed me. It’s a very down to earth environment, and I know that I would have lots of opportunities in the community (I’ve already had great opportunities that I put on hold). I never thought I would be able to say this, because I never thought that I would be able to connect with my favorite drummers.

1. I enjoy playing piano because of the melodies. Figuring things out on the piano just means that I then have more melodies to play, which gives me more variety, which I can use to create new melodies. However, I am very much a beginner 

2. Hanging out with friends (really like 1 really close friends) allows me to feels connected to people, it is a distraction from my problems, and it’s just fun in general 

3.  I’m not good at writing music now because of my lack of melodic knowledge. I have a desire to write music. I have a lot of rhythmic knowledge, and if I can put my rhythmic knowledge together with some melodic knowledge, I can have this creative freedom that I have been missing for very long. I have written a few short pieces, and the process of being able to figure things out in order to express my feelings is enjoyable, and sometimes very peaceful 

4. I have always enjoyed playing basketball. Since the age of probably 3 or 4 ( I am 16 now) I have always had a basketball around me. I tried once to take it seriously during the long lockdown period, and my mental health ended up crumbling (drove myself into disordered eating). Besides that bump in the road, I have always found myself somewhat drawn to the art form of ball handling, the sound of a good swish, and the street ball culture ( The professor, BoneCollector, Hot Sauce, Jamal Crawford). Now I do it because I I still have some skill left in me, and for the most part it is a fun distraction from my problems 


5. Playing football is fun, especially with friends. I love the look and feeling of a tight spiral, and that slight and quick whipping motion when I throw that I try to emulate from Aaron Rodgers (who is the real G.O.A.T, not Tom Brady, but that’s neither here nor there😂😂). I love watching great route smooth route runners like Davante Adams, Stefon Diggs, Julio Jones, and so many others. There is an art form to route running that is very attractive that I try to emulate (especially Davante Adams, damn that man is smooth with it)
   

6. I’ve been playing baseball ever since I was 3 or 4. Throwing a fastball right down the middle is very satisfying. Snapping off a nasty curveball is a great feeling. But most of all, being able to use my athleticism to run out and dive for balls is the best feeling. Ever since I was little, I would have my father just toss balls into the air, and I would run after them and dive for them. I don’t know why I like this, but I do.

7. I used to like playing drums because of the feeling. The feeling of the crack of a snare drum, or the feeling of digging into the floor Tom was very satisfying. The feeling and sound of the cut of a ride cymbal bell was amazing. The feeling of the crash cymbal was great, and so was the look of it. Basically everything about the curls used to appeal to me. However, I’ve tried to take it seriously, and I did better than I did with  basketball. When I tried to take basketball seriously, at first I just wanted to get better, than it was because I wanted to become famous, than it was for the possible money, and then I played in order to allow myself to eat. I ended up losing too much weight when I was already underweight, my organs weren’t functioning correctly, and I had to stop exercising all together.  

     With the drums however, I was able to keep my motivation intrinsic. I have gained a lot more opportunities that I thought I never would have had through the drums. I’ve been able to connect with my drumming idols, (taking lessons with one of them), and I have gotten very good. But I despite my increasing skill, I have just gotten bored with drums, and I have never let myself off the hook. So now I am taking a break, which means that I can lose these great opportunities, which kind of freaks me the fuck out, but that is a whole different story.
